planets.name: Ross 176 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Ross 176 with a 5.01-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: Ross 176 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Ross 176. Its orbit and size follow Geraldía-González et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
